summary.what_it_does: Photoroom provides AI tools for turning product photos into listing images and short video ads. Its background remover produces cutouts for white or transparent backgrounds, and its AI product photography feature generates studio-style shots from an uploaded product photo. A brand library lets users save colors, logos, fonts and layouts so images stay consistent across channels. Batch processing applies edits across many images at once through the web app or an API, with marketplace-ready exports and publishing to Shopify and other marketplace feeds. An enterprise tier adds custom models, dedicated capacity and SLA-backed uptime.
